heldClaims.claimText: Historical rule (Academic Integrity Policy 2022 as described in the Teaching@Sydney FAQ): students could only use assistance, including automated writing tools, if the unit of study outline expressly permitted it. claims.text: University of Sydney academic decisions and misconduct findings use different review routes. Where the Registrar makes a misconduct finding or penalty, the student may appeal to the Student Disciplinary Appeals Committee (SDAC) within 20 working days of the penalty notice. Not every AI-related academic integrity matter is a Registrar misconduct decision.

coursework.en: Each unit outline has a 'Use of AI' column for every assessment. AI can be used in open (unsupervised) assessments, where educators guide appropriate use and use must be acknowledged; it generally cannot be used in secure (supervised) assessments unless the unit coordinator expressly permits it. These coursework rules do not apply to HDR theses.
coursework.zh: 每门课程大纲都有“Use of AI”一栏，逐项标明各考核能否使用 AI。开放式（无监督）考核可以使用 AI，由教师指导适当用法且须声明；安全（有监督）考核一般不得使用，除非课程负责人明确许可。上述课程规则不适用于研究型学位（HDR）论文。

exams.en: Secure (supervised) assessments, such as secure exams, generally prohibit AI unless the unit coordinator gives express permission in the unit outline; using AI where prohibited can breach the Academic Integrity Policy.
exams.zh: 安全（有监督）考核（如安全考试）一般禁止使用 AI，除非课程负责人在大纲中明确许可；在禁止的情况下使用 AI 可能违反《学术诚信政策》。

disclosure.en: AI used in assessments must be acknowledged, including AI translation, paraphrasing or referencing tools; basic spelling/grammar correction and word processing are exempt. The statement gives the tool name and version, publisher, URL and how it was used; coordinators may require logs. HDR theses must include an AI statement even if no AI was used.
disclosure.zh: 在考核中使用 AI 必须声明，包括 AI 翻译、改写或参考文献工具；文字处理和基础拼写语法纠正除外。声明须写明工具名称和版本、发布方、网址及用途；课程负责人可要求提交使用记录。研究型学位论文即使未使用 AI 也须附 AI 声明。

privacy_data.en: Do not enter confidential, personal, proprietary or otherwise sensitive information into AI tools. Inputting University teaching or course materials, other students' work, external partners' intellectual property or anyone's personal or health information counts as misuse. HDR students must never upload personal, sensitive or confidential information to any AI tool.
privacy_data.zh: 不得向 AI 工具输入机密、个人、专有或其他敏感信息。输入学校教学或课程材料、其他学生的作品、外部合作方知识产权或任何人的个人或健康信息均属不当使用。研究型学位学生不得向任何 AI 工具上传个人、敏感或机密信息。

approved_tools.en: Microsoft Copilot Chat is free for all students and is the go-to option when signed in via Okta (only some highly protected data). Cogniti agents are provided through units; Harvey AI is for Sydney Law School students only. ChatGPT Edu is not yet generally available: a student pilot is planned for October 2026 and release to all students in Semester 1 2027, with agents and connectors assessed before enabling. Tool access does not override an assessment's AI rules.
approved_tools.zh: Microsoft Copilot Chat 对全体学生免费，经 Okta 登录后为首选工具（仅限部分高度受保护数据）。Cogniti 智能体由课程提供；Harvey AI 仅供悉尼法学院学生使用。ChatGPT Edu 尚未全面开放：计划 2026 年 10 月开展学生试点，2027 年第一学期向全体学生推出，智能体和连接器需先评估后开启。能使用工具不改变考核的 AI 规则。

research_publication.en: HDR (research degree) students may use AI for spelling and grammar but not to generate content, rewrite drafts' academic language or include AI output as substantive thesis content, unless AI is integral to the approved research methodology (supervisor approval and ethics arrangements). Theses need an AI statement and students should keep prompts and outputs.
research_publication.zh: 研究型学位（HDR）学生可用 AI 改进拼写和语法，但不得用于生成内容、上传草稿润色学术语言或把 AI 输出作为论文实质内容，除非 AI 是经导师批准并纳入伦理审批的研究方法组成部分。论文须附 AI 声明，并应保留提示词和输出记录。

academic_integrity.en: Inappropriately generating content with AI is an academic integrity breach and AI-generated submissions may be treated as contract cheating. Turnitin's AI detector may be used, but its score is never the only evidence. Minor breaches may be handled by the unit coordinator, more serious ones by the faculty Educational Integrity team, and the most serious by the Registrar. Academic decisions: faculty/Academic Panel review within 20 working days, then SAB within 15 working days; Registrar misconduct penalties: SDAC appeal within 20 working days.
academic_integrity.zh: 不当使用 AI 生成内容属于学术诚信违规，AI 生成的提交物可被视为代写。可使用 Turnitin AI 检测，但其分数绝不是唯一证据。轻微违规可由课程负责人处理，较严重的由学院教育诚信团队处理，最严重的由教务长（Registrar）处理。学术决定：20 个工作日内申请学院/学术小组复核，之后 15 个工作日内向学生申诉机构（SAB）申诉；教务长作出的纪律处分：20 个工作日内向学生纪律申诉委员会（SDAC）申诉。

teaching_guidance.en: The University of Sydney recommends a two-lane assessment framework to guide teaching and assessment design in the age of generative AI: Lane 1 assures learning through secured, in-person assessments where generative AI may or may not be allowed by the examiner, while Lane 2 scaffolds and supports relevant generative AI use in open assessments; under the Assessment Procedures, unit of study coordinators specify for each assessment whether and which AI tools are permitted and how use must be acknowledged.
teaching_guidance.zh: 悉尼大学建议采用双轨考核框架指导生成式 AI 时代的教学与考核设计：第一轨通过现场安全考核（secured, in person）确保核心学习成果，考核中是否允许使用生成式 AI 由主考人员决定；第二轨在开放式考核中为学生合理使用相关生成式 AI 提供支持与脚手架；依据《考核程序》，各课程协调人须在每项考核中明确说明是否及允许使用何种 AI 工具以及具体的致谢声明方式。

security_procurement.en: Central IT security evaluation protocols, vendor data privacy impact assessments, and institutional procurement standards for third-party generative AI platforms are not verified in current reviewed university records.
security_procurement.zh: 针对第三方生成式 AI 平台的中央 IT 安全评估规程、供应商数据隐私影响评估及机构采购准入标准，在当前已审查的大学公开记录中尚未核实。

cl-the-university-of-sydney-microsoft-co.text: The University of Sydney Student IT page describes Microsoft Copilot as a University-endorsed GenAI tool, free for all students and accessed by signing in with a University account; students may use it for assessments provided they use AI tools responsibly, which still depends on each assessment's AI rules.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Copilot is a University endorsed GenAI tool and is free for all students. You're welcome to use it for assessments provided you are aware of how to use AI tools responsibly.
evidence.location: Microsoft Copilot; lines 172-172 of captured page text

draft-claim-usyd-academic-appeal-routes.text: University of Sydney academic decisions and misconduct findings use different review routes. For academic decisions, students may apply for faculty or Academic Panel review within 20 working days, and may appeal to the Student Appeals Body (SAB) within 15 working days of the review outcome, but not simply because they disagree with it. Where the Registrar makes a misconduct finding or penalty, the student may appeal to the Student Disciplinary Appeals Committee (SDAC) within 20 working days of the penalty notice. Not every AI-related academic integrity matter is a Registrar misconduct decision.

evidence.quote:
If an informal resolution doesn’t resolve your concerns, the next level available to you is to apply for a review from the relevant faculty or administrative unit.
You must apply within 20 working days of receiving:

evidence.quote: If you apply for a SAB appeal, you must apply within 15 working days of receiving the outcome of your faculty or Academic Panel review. If you are granted an extension, you must apply within the extended timeframe.

draft-claim-usyd-hdr-genai-rules.text: Higher degree by research (HDR) students at the University of Sydney do not inherit the open-assessment AI permission. The Graduate Research guidance says generative AI may in general be used to improve spelling or grammar (spelling/grammar checkers and reference managers are permitted) but not to generate content; prompting AI to generate written or other content, uploading a draft to improve its academic language, and incorporating AI outputs as substantive thesis content are prohibited, except where AI is integral to the research design or methodology and approved by the supervisor and through the ethics arrangements. HDR students should never enter personal, sensitive or confidential information into any gen AI tool.

evidence.quote: In general terms, gen AI tools may be used where, for example, they assist in improving the spelling or grammar of your writing, but not where they generate content for you.
evidence.location: Use of generative AI: General overview; lines 316-316 of captured page text

evidence.quote: However, inputting prompts into a gen AI tool (e.g. Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.) to generate written or other content; uploading a draft of your work into a gen AI tool to improve the academic language or any other aspect of your work; and/or incorporating gen AI outputs as substantive content in your thesis or other submitted work are all prohibited, except under certain circumstances as outlined under ‘Responsible use of generative AI in research’.
evidence.location: Use of generative AI: General overview; lines 320-320 of captured page text

evidence.quote: The responsible use of gen AI tools may be permitted when it is integral to your research design or methodology and its use has been approved by your supervisor.
evidence.location: Responsible use of generative AI in research; lines 324-324 of captured page text

evidence.quote: If you are considering using any form of gen AI or gen AI-assisted technology as part of your research methodology or in ways integral to your research project, you must check with your supervisor first to confirm whether this is permitted.  Then it should be approved as part of your ethics arrangements.
evidence.location: Responsible use of generative AI in research; lines 326-326 of captured page text

evidence.quote: Never enter or upload any personal, sensitive or confidential information into any gen AI tool.
